'''Edu Harn''' was an elderly [[Gender/Legends|woman]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. She had suffered an attack by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] at some point, and was considered to be senile by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TM" />
